modules.title: 改一个等待上限，看页面是否等到响应
超时发生时发生了什么

items.title: 等待端主动放弃
items.text: 等待某个阶段超过上限时，页面或工具会停止等待并报告超时。本例请求已到服务端；其他超时可能发生在连接、发送或读取阶段。

items.title: 超时不等于出错
items.text: 响应慢、服务器忙、数据量大都可能超过上限。失败信号只说明“等不到结果”，原因仍要结合耗时和日志判断。

items.title: 和限流区分开
items.text: 限流是单位时间请求太多，很快返回 429；超时是等了很久仍没有响应。两者要分开处理。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 把超时上限设得很长并不能解决问题：页面会一直转圈，用户以为卡住。先查连接、发送还是读取阶段超时，再决定上限和重试；重复提交可能让同一操作生效多次。

lessonPractice.title: 提交表单后页面显示“请求超时”，但服务端日志显示这次请求正在正常处理，几十秒后数据其实写入了。这说明什么？

options.label: 前端等待上限太短，提前放弃了等待；服务器仍在继续处理
options.feedback: 超时只发生在等待的一端：页面按上限放弃了，不取消服务器正在进行的处理，数据随后仍会被写入。

options.label: 服务器处理到一半崩溃了，数据不可能写入
options.feedback: 日志显示处理正常完成且数据已写入，崩溃与观察到的结果不符。

options.label: 请求根本没有发出去，是网络断开了
options.feedback: 服务端日志里有这次请求的记录，说明请求已经到达并正在被处理。

en.title: A form shows request timed out, but server logs show the request was processed normally and the data was written tens of seconds later. What does this show?

options.label: The client's wait limit was too short; it gave up while the server kept working
options.feedback: This example assumes the request reached the service: the page stopped waiting at its limit, but the service may have continued and written the data. The timeout alone does not prove the final result.

options.label: The server crashed halfway, so the data could not have been written
options.feedback: The logs show the request completed normally and the data was written, which contradicts a crash.

options.label: The request was never sent because the network was down
options.feedback: The server log contains this request, proving it arrived and was being processed.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 保存接口有时超过 10 秒才返回，页面显示请求超时，但数据实际写入了。请检查接口哪一步慢，并给这次请求设置合适的等待上限和重试规则；不要让页面在请求仍在处理时重复提交。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The save API sometimes takes over 10 seconds, the page reports a timeout, but the data is actually written. Find which step is slow, set a reasonable wait limit and retry rule for this request, and prevent duplicate submissions while it is still processing.

references.title: HTTP 语义：408 与请求等待

learning.assumes: You have seen a page spin for a long time before failing, or a build interrupted after a long wait.
learning.outcome: You can identify whether a timeout happened during connection, sending, or response wait, distinguish it from rate limiting or a bad request, and know work may continue if the service received it.

modules.title: Change one wait limit and see whether the page gets a response
What happens when a timeout fires

items.title: The waiting side gives up
items.text: When a wait phase exceeds its limit, the page or tool stops waiting and reports a timeout. If the request reached the service, work may continue there; a connection or send timeout can happen before the service receives the request.

items.title: A timeout is not an error verdict
items.text: A slow response, a busy server, or large data can all exceed the limit. The failure signal only says no result arrived; the cause still needs timing and logs.

items.title: Different from rate limiting
items.text: Rate limiting rejects too many requests per period and returns 429 quickly. A timeout means waiting a long time with no response. They need different handling.

modules.title: What it does not fix
modules.text: Setting a very long timeout does not solve the problem: the page spins and users think it is stuck. First check whether the connection, send, or response wait timed out; then choose the limit and retry rule. Duplicate submissions can apply an action more than once.

distinctions.label: Rate limit
distinctions.text: A rate limit caps how many requests may run in a period and returns 429 quickly. A timeout caps how long one operation waits for a result. They are different failure causes.

distinctions.label: A malformed request
distinctions.text: A malformed request may get a quick 4xx response. A timeout means one waiting phase exceeded its limit; inspect the request to learn where. HTTP 408 specifically means a server timed out while waiting for the client to send a complete request message.
